response.overview: # Akasyah Alimin, he is the most sought-after widower by women. Losing his beloved wife caused him to become a lonely person. His time is only spent on work and his patients. Until he doesn't realize, his actions invite disappointment in the heart of a small boy named Adam. The only precious gem left by the late Zahida. "If father loves Adam, father cannot break his promise. Father said he would come early... but father didn't come. If Adam still had mother... surely mother wouldn't let Adam wait long at school." - Adam  Dahlia Suhana. The memory of that puppy love was never forgotten. Although years have passed, the first man she silently loved still lives in her heart. Although she is someone's fiancée, yet he is the one she waits for.  Wan Daniel, he is the greatest casanova. He never stays with any woman. For him, love is like changing clothes. No need to stay long. Who would have thought his heart would yield to a chubby, cute girl.
